svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Triad Drift HUD - Dominion assault
svg.text: 5% safe margin (96 px / 54 px) - guide only, not drawn in game
Generator pips: filled diamond = alive, hollow slashed = destroyed (shape + colour), plus the 2 / 4 count
Reactor bar 480x26: replaces the pips when state = ReactorExposed (dashed: not shown yet)
Generator marker: ringed diamond 40 px + health bar + distance; name only on the current target
Generators are the objective markers (tag TD.Objective.Marker)
Hyperdrive blocked text shows only on a hyperdrive press here (never permanent)
